metadata.title: Partners & Sponsors | Teacher Gamer
metadata.description: Organizations supporting Teacher-Gamer — and how to collaborate as a partner or sponsor.

hero.title: <accent>Partners</accent> & Sponsors
hero.body: We are grateful to the companies, schools, and brands that help grow game-based learning with Teacher-Gamer. Want to join them? Tell us how you would like to work together.

featured.title: Featured organizations
featured.empty: Partner and sponsor logos will appear here as we announce collaborations.

daVinciLifeSkills.description: Da Vinci Life-Skills is a non‑profit education organisation that provides a biophilic, project‑based curriculum, a skills‑based assessment framework, and certified mentor training to help schools and home‑education communities deliver holistic, real‑world learning where students can flourish.

rpgDojo.description: A digital community for studying, playing, chatting, and learning more about TTRPGs.

heroWorkshop.description: The Hero Workshop supports young people through story-driven, game-based experiences that build confidence, creativity, and social-emotional growth.

undiscoveredCountry.description: Undiscovered Country provides peace‑and‑conflict diagnostics, archetype profiling, and training programmes that help organisations and schools understand tensions, transform conflict, and build healthier, more harmonious cultures.

upcraftCrew.description: Full-stack engineering support for teams fixing delivery bottlenecks, refactors, and MVP builds.

gaiaKids.description: A global arts‑for‑impact initiative that empowers children to use creativity to spark social change, advocate for environmental justice, and build community through collaborative art projects.

cultivate.description: Cultivate is a small, empathic, research‑informed school for ages 6–14 where learning through play, connection, creativity, and project‑based learning empowers children to belong, collaborate, and flourish as active participants in their own education.

vitaEquilibrium.description: VitaEquilibrium offers movement‑based, contemplative workshops and retreats—rooted in somatic movement practices like 5Rhythms—that help people cultivate balance, connection, and a more harmonious way of living.

workWithUs.title: Work with us
workWithUs.body: Ready to explore a partnership or sponsorship? Choose the path that fits you and complete a short survey — we will follow up from there.

partner.title: Become a partner
partner.body: Programs, co-design, training, community — tell us what you have in mind.

sponsor.title: Become a sponsor
sponsor.body: Support missions, tours, scholarships, or events — share your goals here.
